meta.heldout_is: UNSEEN PAIRINGS, not unseen nouns (doc 54 SS6.1.1). Every noun's feature is in-inventory by construction, which is what makes doc 54 SS4.3's inventory-wide PCA fit legitimate and what makes doc 54 SS10's scope limit binding: exp68 does NOT test novel-filler generalisation.

coverage_assertion.rule: every bearer AND every non-bearer appears in >= 1 TRAIN cast (doc 54 SS6.1.1)

meta.construction: SB (doc 46 SS5): one event, two-referent cast, exactly one category bearer; twins exchange the agent/patient roles over an IDENTICAL cast with an IDENTICAL question surface and opposite labels, so V1 is exactly 0.500 and neither content alone nor position alone can solve it. exp68's category is a REAL semantic category (non-occupational state) and is carried by the per-referent FEATURE MAP -- the raw AraVec PCA coordinates of doc 54 SS6.2 -- never by the surface.
invariants_asserted: test casts are disjoint from train and val casts (unseen pairings)
every bearer and every non-bearer appears in >= 1 train cast
every pair: identical cast, identical wire order, identical question surface, one rendering, opposite answers
exactly one bearer in every cast
answer == yes iff the agent is a real bearer
answer classes balanced in every split
n_test == 300, matching exp60/exp61 so doc 54 SS7's 0.06 bar transfers
